title: Preventing Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
requirement: Bars real estate lessors, agents and subcontractors from subscribing to or contracting with a service provider that collects competitor information to recommend rents, and bars service providers from facilitating agreements not to compete.
coverage_conditions: Applies to real estate lessors of residential dwelling units, their agents and subcontractors, and service providers in Jersey City. Excludes licensed real estate agents acting per state regulations and owners acting only on their own properties.

applicability.per_tenancy: Exempts owners of multiple properties for actions related exclusively to properties they control, and licensed real estate agents operating under state regulations.

exemptions: Owners of multiple properties acting exclusively as to properties they control; licensed real estate agents complying with state regulations.
penalty: First violation punishable under Chapter 1, Art. I, § 1-25; subsequent violations fined $100–$2,000; each day is a separate violation. Private right of action with costs and attorney fees.
quoted_span: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
